title: Test: reconciliation converges when nodes diverge by >MAX_HAVE entries
description:
reconcile() silently caps output at MAX_HAVE=1000 entries with no completeness signal (o0r.18). No test verifies that repeated reconciliation rounds eventually converge when the divergence exceeds MAX_HAVE.

Write a property test (or deterministic integration test) in crates/core/tests/ that:
1. Creates two MemLogStorage instances
2. Appends N > MAX_HAVE entries to node A that node B has not seen
3. Runs reconciliation rounds (alternating A→B and B→A calls to reconcile()) until both nodes agree on the same tip set
4. Asserts convergence within ceil(N / MAX_HAVE) + 1 rounds
5. Also tests the N < MAX_HAVE case converges in 1 round

Independent oracle: both storages have identical tip sets after convergence; verified by comparing get_tips() output, not by comparing against the code path under test.
